promise: Provide $3.9 billion for the ninth replenishment of the Global Environment Facility, covering July 2026 to June 2030
description: Donors announced initial pledges of USD 3.9 billion on April 9, 2026 for GEF-9. The Council subsequently endorsed programming for July 2026 through June 2030.
evidence: The later Council announcement confirms the USD 3.9 billion programming level and four-year cycle; it does not establish full payment by donors.
